_comment: Joint configurations of the three grasps in the published grasp-selection figure.
They were solved by the revision of the solver at commit cd0a354 (2026-08-13) and
cannot be regenerated from a random seed: branch selection and the solver's joint box
both changed afterwards, so today's solver converges to a different set of grasps for
essentially every seed. Recovered from the archived Meshcat scene by fitting Drake's
forward kinematics to the exported link transforms (residual < 3e-8).
Pass with --configurations to reproduce the published figure exactly; omit it to solve
fresh grasps with the current solver.
